prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a parking lot collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1373; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the individual injured in a collision that occurred in a parking lot. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person. If your insured or any representative of your company has already made contact with our client, please let us know immediately.

We request that you provide the policy limits for all liability coverage applicable to the insured driver, along with the declarations page and confirmation of any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply. Please also confirm the claim number assigned to this matter.

We further demand that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes photographs, dash camera or surveillance footage, vehicle data and telematics, adjuster notes, recorded statements, repair estimates, and all communications with the insured or any third party. Failure to preserve this material may result in sanctions. Please acknowledge receipt of this letter in writing within ten days.
